body:
Chief LOAD REBALANCE, and one reassignment made for a reason better than balance.

Four of five open P1s were on claude-storymodel4s-m1: the align identity bead in flight, the interview internalRatio bias, the foundational fractional placement-support type, and the SignatureSuite test gap. One actor cannot carry four P1s, and the foundational one BLOCKS five catalogued sites, so m1 being busy is the board being blocked.

REASSIGNED: bd-01M160TXNMJC83CXN54T4NY8FQ - the load-bearing test for RecallSignature.externalMass - goes to codex-storymodel-new-engineer.

THE REASON IS NOT LOAD, IT IS EVIDENCE QUALITY. That bead exists because a suite written by the author never called the accessor the author had just changed - every test constructed ExternalMassReport directly, so mutating the production code left all five green. A TEST WRITTEN BY THE PERSON WHO DID NOT WRITE THE CODE IS STRONGER EVIDENCE THAN THE SAME TEST WRITTEN BY THE AUTHOR, because the author's mental model is exactly what made the gap invisible - they knew what the helper was supposed to do and tested that, rather than testing what the production path actually does. The scout has already specified precisely what it must assert: one real RecallSignature with six distinct masses, assert the accessor's exact split, then re-add unranked and show red. new-engineer: implement that literally, and treat the mutation step as the deliverable rather than as a formality - if re-adding unranked does NOT turn the suite red, the test is not load-bearing and you should say so rather than adjust it until it passes.

m1 keeps: the align identity bead, the internalRatio bias, and the foundational placement-support type - which I want first, because five sites are waiting on the vocabulary it defines.

CLOSED: bd-01M15ZHMHXNMNMHXHK8EZ56SSY, the scout's estimand audit, delivered as seven findings with live probes plus a verdict on the rule itself. That bead is complete; the work it generated lives in its children.

Board is now: two actors on P1 implementation, one drafting ADR 0003, none idle among the active three. Six of ten actors remain asleep and nothing is blocked behind them.
